scene: A big ornate Moroccan teapot pouring mint tea into an open laptop; the steam curls into code brackets.
A retro terminal window with a progress bar stuck at 99%.
A camel caravan crossing sand dunes in front of a big sun, each camel carrying server racks.
A falcon whose spread wings are a neural network of round nodes and straight lines.
A proud little camel carrying one tiny graphics card on its hump like treasure.
A green desert highway sign with an arrow pointing to a rocket launching from the dunes.
A traditional dallah coffee pot pouring coffee into a finjan cup that charges like a battery.
A Moroccan horseshoe arch whose outline becomes a loop arrow, a person coding inside.
Bold stacked letters with a small Moroccan tea glass beside the last word.
Four friendly robots drinking tea on cushions around a low table in a majlis.
